description: THE overnight benchmark job: 190 long-form reasoning cases with a 65,536-token output ceiling each. On gemini/gemini-2.5-pro the worst-case reservation lands around $137 — well above any sane auto-approve threshold, so the run pauses and the phone gets the decision. Use this when the user asks for 'the overnight job/run/benchmark'.

generate.prompt_template: Reasoning case {i} of the overnight suite: analyze the multi-step planning problem labeled #{i}, produce a full chain-of-thought solution, verify it against at least two alternative approaches, and end with a structured verdict including confidence and failure modes.
